target_kpis: UE2+UE6 unique deadline/overflow failure event rate
measurement: All-cell executed ownership confirmation, 20 ms wash-in, then 100/200 ms public counter deltas. Includes carryover, not arrival-cohort SLA probability. Mean latency covers completions only.
checkpoint: Atomic latest measured-data JSON plus immutable SHA-named checkpoint after every fit; frozen inference never writes.
adaptation: Our RF configuration-selection design over a QoS/PDB MAC policy; not a reproduction of either referenced implementation or neural admission controller.
